description: List recent runs of a specific OpenClaw cron job. Wraps `cron.runs`. Pass `compact: true` to truncate each run's `summary` to 200 chars (saves tokens when scanning many runs); a `summaryTruncated` flag is added per entry. Each entry also gets a `runAtAgo` field (e.g. "3h ago") for readability.

compact.description: Truncate each run's summary to 200 chars

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

summaryMaxChars.description: Override the truncation length when compact=true (default 200)

name: openclaw_cron_runs
